name: io.github.cshum/imagor-mcp
title: Imagor MCP
description: An MCP server and a skill for imagor. An agent writes a layout (OG cards, product grids, quotes) and it compiles to one imagor URL.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where imagor is running, for example http://localhost:8000. Defaults to http://localhost:8000.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_UNSAFE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 when the imagor server runs in unsafe mode, for trying things out. The server will not start without IMAGOR_UNSAFE or IMAGOR_SECRET.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The signing secret, when the imagor server is signed. The alternative to IMAGOR_UNSAFE; the server will not start without one of the two.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_SIGNER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Signature algorithm the imagor server is configured with: sha1 (default), sha256 or sha512. Must match the server or emitted URLs will not validate.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_SIGNER_TRUNCATE
environmentVariables.description: Signature length in characters, when the imagor server truncates signatures. Must match the server or emitted URLs will not validate.
